title: Evaluation preserved by circuit translation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a straight-line program on $n$ Boolean inputs, and let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to those inputs. Evaluating the circuit associated with $P$ on $x$ gives the same Boolean value as evaluating $P$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean assignment $x$ to the $n$ inputs
